profile.summary: A public school district in western Contra Costa County, California, serving more than 29,000 students in 54 schools across five communities. It provides kindergarten through 12th grade education. It runs its own Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA) and special education programs, including a transition program for young adults ages 18 to 22.
